falseSynonyms.zh: 證據不等於例子 evidence 是用來支持或反駁主張的證據；example 可以幫助說明，但未必足以構成證據。
falseSynonyms.point: An example may illustrate a claim, while evidence is used to support it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 樣本只對部分 examples sample 通常是從較大集合抽取的一部分，或供展示的作品片段。
falseSynonyms.point: A writing sample is an example of someone's work, but not every example is a sample.

falseSynonyms.zh: 範本／榜樣不等於一般例子 model 通常值得模仿或用作參照。
falseSynonyms.point: A model answer is an example to imitate; an ordinary example may simply illustrate a point.

falseSynonyms.zh: 案例研究比 example 更深入 case study 通常包含詳細背景、分析和結論。
falseSynonyms.point: A case study is an extended example, not just a brief instance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 證明比 example 更強 proof 表示足以確立某主張為真的證明；example 通常只能說明或支持。
falseSynonyms.point: One example may support an idea without proving it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 類別不等於例子 category 是分類；example 是該類中的具體成員。
falseSynonyms.point: Fruit is a category; an apple is an example.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定義不等於例子 definition 解釋詞義；example 展示詞語／概念如何實際出現。
falseSynonyms.point: A definition tells you what a word means; an example shows how it is used.

falseSynonyms.zh: 類比不等於例子 analogy 透過相似關係幫助理解；它可能不是目標概念的真實 instance。
falseSynonyms.point: An analogy compares similar structures; an example is an actual instance.
